scope_proof: Removing only the new DataActive helper, ordinary LOG admission rejection, policy duplicate-count exception and policy snapshot function in memory reproduces the prior frozen e3303be source hash exactly. No source was edited by reviewer.
checked: DATA admission and policy snapshot use the same effective CCCD/FAST/SAFE predicate under the existing s_bleMux; indication-only DATA is inactive in FAST and active in SAFE.
Policy applies only to channel LOG with priority=false after normal sendability/epoch checks; CTRL and lifecycle priority slots bypass it.
No queue drain, owner cancellation, active buffer reuse or task deletion is introduced; already accepted/inflight LOG completes normally even if DATA is enabled between fragments.
Each policy rejection increments logPolicyDrop, dropped[LOG] and messageDropped exactly once. NotifyInternal returns ESP_ERR_NOT_ALLOWED and does not count a second drop.

Policy rejections do not increment slot-allocation failure, stale-generation, SDK, guard or fragment-error counters. TransportStatResult increments its separate bleLogDrop and releases its descriptor; it does not report successful submission.
AsyncLog -> NetLogPublish -> TransportProcessDescriptor/StatResult does not recurse into error logging, retry or matrix recovery/MFAULT on policy rejection; Wi-Fi fanout remains independent.
DATA unsubscribe restores ordinary LOG admission; disconnect/reconnect clears CCCDs normally while boot counters persist. Finite counter wrap is tested.
BLELOG? is read-only v1 capability probe with no setter. Actual formatter maximum tested response is227 bytes within512; other replies unchanged.
test_coverage: Actual production functions under ASan/UBSan for priority/ownership;8 CCCD-mode cases,4 unavailable cases,LOG-only restore/epoch/stale classification,critical bypass,accepted owner completion,exact-once/wrap counters,query read-only;36 real-notification receiver roundtrips;22 pipeline scenarios including stuck-owner quarantine and separate policy/transport counters.
contract_boundaries: dataActive means an effective DATA subscription on a sendable connection, not actual frames per second or a nonempty DATA queue. A paused acquisition retaining DATA CCCD still suppresses new ordinary LOG. Disable DATA subscription for LOG-only operation.

policyDrop is a boot modulo32 subset of dropL. These are intentional ordinary-diagnostic rejections, not scientific DATA loss. Counters from different pipeline layers are not independent losses to sum.
Previously accepted LOG may finish after DATA subscription activates. No cancellation or instant wire silence is claimed.
Critical priority is local admission/service; SDK acceptance is not PC receipt.
No radio/HIL, throughput acceptance, board access, firmware flash or full-build claim is made by this review; root handles actual build and HIL.
